root.label: Texas districts launch Alpha AI pilot programs

events.label: Texas districts launch Alpha AI pilot programs

slots.name: district pilots
slots.sentence: After the coordination, at least three of those districts — Houston; Fort Davis, in West Texas; and Aldine, near Houston — launched pilot programs incorporating the AI tool.

slots.name: Fort Davis enrollment
slots.sentence: Michelle Hartmann, deputy superintendent at Fort Davis, which enrolls around 800 students, said it will deploy the model in its K-8 classrooms for students who need additional help in reading and math.

slots.name: Aldine pilot students
slots.sentence: Aldine will deploy the online platform to roughly 300 students across four middle school campuses that require support in math.

slots.name: districts declined
slots.sentence: In all, ProPublica and the Tribune identified at least five school districts — Ector County, Fort Bend, Irving, Pecos and Pflugerville — that confirmed they were approached about partnering with Alpha but did not pursue an agreement.

slots.name: pilot payment status
slots.sentence: The office said Houston ISD wasn’t paying Alpha for the pilot but did not provide more details.
